releaseName: Lokify v1.4.0 – Direct In-App Updater & Centered Notifications
releaseNotes:
• Direct In-App APK Updater: Updates strictly download and prompt installation on screen without opening any external browser or navigating away.
• Center Screen Notifications: All alerts, notices, and SMS popups appear in the exact center of the screen with a dedicated OK button.
• Clean Header: Removed redundant top-right 2nd button; all admin controls are housed inside individual report cards.
